content.rendered:
Directions given to a particular individual, or identifiable persons, for a particular situation or commission. These include such instructions as Noah building the ark and Peter’s temple-tax direction. A wider lesson may be studied without requiring every reader to repeat the original action.

Each entry retains its topic, original Scripture, audience notes and existing fulfillment classification. A reported human command is distinguished from a command God approves.

General · Personal · Instructions overview

571 study records in this view. Entries can overlap; this is not a count of distinct biblical commands. Ordered by the first source book, chapter and verse.

The source wording follows the Saints Greek-English text: the Septuagint for the Old Testament and the Greek New Testament. Headings and application notes are study summaries. Preserve the passage’s speaker, audience, conditions and grammatical form. Source alignment checked 6 November 2026; independent critical-Greek review remains in progress.
